system.description:
The SR of the skill you have acquired with the tag [Servant Summoning] is treated as +1 (it may exceed the maximum SR). This item cannot be equipped on two or more at the same time. [CR14] The effect of increasing SR by 1 is invalidated.

A transverse flute said to have been favored by Weser, a summoner from the age of the gods. Its tone has the effect of inspiring its followers and amplifying their power.

Bright Crimson Petal [Core Material] (60G) + Pine Wand (140G) + [Magic Catalyst 4] (30G) x 3 + Crafting Cost (100G)
